title: Balanced Brackets with a Stack
statement: You are given a string made only of the characters ( ) [ ] { }. A string is balanced if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket, and brackets close in the correct order. Use a stack. Print YES if the string is balanced. Print NO otherwise.
inputFormat: One line with a string of length N. It has only the characters ( ) [ ] { }.
outputFormat: Print YES if the brackets are balanced. Otherwise print NO.
constraints: There are no spaces in the line
explanations: Each bracket closes right after it opens, with the same type. So the string is balanced and the answer is YES.
The ] arrives while the top of the stack is (. The types do not match, so the answer is NO.
